tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve DNS records (A/AAAA/MX/TXT/NS/CNAME/SOA) for a domain, queried live against 1.1.1.1. Use when you need to verify a domain resolves, check mail routing, or inspect TXT/SPF records.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: Inspect a host's TLS certificate: issuer, subject, SAN list, expiry date and days remaining. Use to catch expiring or misconfigured certificates.

tools.name: http_head
tools.description: Fetch a URL and report HTTP status, total latency in ms, key response headers (server, cache, content-type) and the page title. Use as a cheap liveness/uptime probe.

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Audit HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) and return a 0-100 score with the missing ones listed.

tools.name: redirect_chain
tools.description: Follow a URL through its full redirect chain (up to 8 hops) and report each hop's status code and Location target. Use to detect redirect loops or http->https and www canonicalisation issues.

tools.name: seo_snapshot
tools.description: Extract on-page SEO signals from a URL: title, meta description, canonical, robots meta, h1 count, Open Graph tags, and word count. Use for quick SEO triage without a browser.

tools.name: robots_txt
tools.description: Fetch and parse a site's robots.txt into allow/disallow rules and declared sitemaps. Use before crawling a site to respect its policy.

tools.name: ip_echo
tools.description: Return the caller's public IP address and reverse DNS name. Use to confirm which egress IP an agent or service is presenting.

tools.name: site_audit
tools.description: Run the full audit bundle in one call: SSL + security headers + redirect chain + HTTP head + DNS + SEO. Use when you need a complete health picture of a site rather than one signal.
